title: Japanese Stir-Fried Fenugreek
description: A quick and flavorful Japanese-inspired fenugreek stir-fry that can be served as a side dish or added to a variety of meals.
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the fenugreek greens and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until wilted.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar.
Pour the sauce over the fenugreek greens and stir-fry for another minute.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional fenugreek greens if desired.
Optional: add protein like tofu or tempeh for added nutrition and flavor.
